audit_basis: JSON was parsed line by line and required fields were checked.
The compiled catalog was compared with every evidence JSON field and with the public docs copy.
Existing gold-content and price-per-gold arithmetic was recomputed where inputs were present.
URLs were checked for HTTPS shape and classified with conservative path/hostname heuristics.
Targeted page observations, when present, are copied into data/source_checks.json; they are not an exhaustive live crawl.
important_limitation: This report does not fetch retailer pages and therefore does not certify that a live page still matches any catalog value. Open each source_url for manual review before relying on price, weight, karat, availability, or product identity.

flag_definitions.duplicate_source_url: More than one catalog row points to the exact same URL; confirm whether these are variants or accidental duplicates.
flag_definitions.price_not_published_in_catalog: No numeric price_usd, price_usd_from, or price_usd_to was stored.
flag_definitions.weight_not_published_in_catalog: No numeric weight_g or weight_g_total was stored.
flag_definitions.non_ring_or_reference_item_heuristic: The row text contains a non-ring jewelry term; this is a review cue, not a final classification.
flag_definitions.third_party_or_marketplace_source: The URL hostname is a marketplace or publication rather than the named seller; it may not be an official product source.
flag_definitions.collection_or_category_source: The URL path looks like a collection/category page rather than a unique product page.
flag_definitions.reference_or_live_page_not_product: The row appears to be reference/live pricing content rather than a product listing.
flag_definitions.source_not_identified_as_product_page: The URL did not match the conservative product-page heuristic.
flag_definitions.live_source_mismatch: A targeted official-page check found a current-page difference from the stored value; read the external_source_check observations.
